{{Quote|Chagras and Xelian were brother and sister&mdash;two of the seven children of Vilia Calimondra.|Arkadia Calimondra|<ref name="Knight Errant" />}}
'''Xelian''', also known as '''Xelian the Destroyer''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. One of seven children of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vilia Calimondra]], Xelian [[Charge Matrica|fought]] in a war between the siblings, to decide which one would become their [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] heir. Xelian also bore two children, [[Odion]] and [[Daiman]], and her preference for Daiman over his brother caused the pair to develop a sibling rivalry. Eventually, Xelian's brother [[Chagras]] emerged as the victor of Calimondra's contest, and Xelian [[Death/Legends|died]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|When her bid began failing, Xelian&mdash;Odion and Daiman's mother&mdash;declared war on Chagras.|Arkadia Calimondra|<ref name="Knight Errant" />}}
[[File:Xelian_and_family.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Xelian, holding up Daiman for her followers to see]]
Xelian, known to some by the sobriquet "Xelian the Destroyer," was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Escape, Part 3" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Knight Errant" /> [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Escape, Part 1" /> who lived during the [[Republic Dark Age]].<ref name="Dark Age">The [[StarWars.com]] article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that the ''Knight Errant'' novel is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], and that Xelian lived during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] preceding the novel. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' identifies this [[Time/Legends|time]] frame as being part of the Republic Dark Age.</ref> She was one of seven children born to [[Vilia Calimondra]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] who had acquired a [[Vilia Calimondra's empire|large empire]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], and Xelian claimed the right to become her [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] only heir. However, Xelian's brother [[Chagras]] and their five other siblings all made similar claims, so Calimondra instigated a contest&mdash;the ''[[Charge Matrica]]''<ref name="Knight Errant" />&mdash;in [[1066 BBY]],<ref name="1066 BBY">The ''Knight Errant'' novel mentions that the ''Charge Matrica'' began 34 years before the events of the book. As the StarWars.com article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in 1032 BBY, this places the start of the contest in 1066 BBY.</ref> to decide which of her children would become her heir. The siblings were tasked with the expansion of Calimondra's holdings, and the Sith Lord planned to appoint as her heir the individual who expanded her territories the farthest. For a [[Time/Legends|time]], Xelian and the other siblings cooperated, but eventually Xelian's bid began to flounder. As a result, she declared war on Chagras, which caused all of the siblings to initiate hostilities against each other.<ref name="Knight Errant" /> To aid her campaign, Xelian had her [[Army/Legends|armies]] adopt a variant of [[the Crucible]] training system, which was first developed by the ancient Sith Lord [[Ieldis]] prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="Escape, Part 1" /> She also established a headquarters for herself, inside a [[temple]]-like structure.<ref name="Escape, Part 3" />

At some point, Xelian gave birth to a son, [[Odion]],<ref name="Knight Errant" /> who became her heir.<ref name="Escape, Part 3" /> In [[1057 BBY]],<ref name="1057 BBY">The ''Knight Errant'' novel mentions that Daiman was born 25 years before the events of the book. As the StarWars.com article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in 1032 BBY, this dates Daiman's birth to 1057 BBY.</ref> she bore another child, who she named [[Daiman]],<ref name="Knight Errant" /> and following his birth, she stood atop a rocky outcrop next to her temple residence and held up her new baby for her followers to see. Daiman quickly displaced Odion as the subject of Xelian's affections, and a sibling rivalry soon developed between the two brothers.<ref name="Escape, Part 3" /> Xelian also eventually became an aunt to Chagras' children, [[Dromika]], [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]], and [[Arkadia Calimondra]].<ref name="Knight Errant" /> During [[1052 BBY]],<ref name="1052 BBY">The ''Knight Errant'' novel mentions that Mandragall died 20 years before the events of the book. As the StarWars.com article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in 1032 BBY, this dates Mandragall's death to 1052 BBY.</ref> Xelian seduced the aging Sith Lord [[Mandragall]] and subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]] him during the night.<ref name="Knight Errant" /> By [[1050 BBY/Legends|1050 BBY]],<ref name="1050 BBY">The ''Knight Errant'' novel mentions that Kerra Holt was born during the period of peace that followed the conclusion of the ''Charge Matrica''. As the StarWars.com article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in 1032 BBY, and the novel states that Holt was 18 years old during the events of the book, this places the conclusion of the ''Charge Matrica'' at sometime before or during 1050 BBY.</ref> Chagras was the only one of Calimondra's children who remained active in the Grumani sector, and he became their mother's heir.<ref name="Knight Errant" /> Xelian herself eventually died,<ref name="Escape, Part 1" /> at some point prior to [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].<ref name="Escape, Part 1" /><ref name="1032 BBY" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But this isn't some silly Republic holodrama where mama liked pretty little Daiman more than ugly Odion. So she found me repulsive, what did it matter?|Odion, on Xelian and his upbringing|<ref name="Escape, Part 3" />}}
Xelian had fair skin and [[Color/Legends|dark]]-colored [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. She preferred her son Daiman over her oldest child Odion, considering Daiman to be pretty and Odion ugly.<ref name="Escape, Part 3" /> The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] leader [[Jarrow Rusher]] thought Xelian to be a monstrous individual.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

==Equipment==
At some point, Xelian wore red [[Clothing|robes]]. While showing Daiman to her followers, she donned a black outfit with a red cape and gold boots.<ref name="Escape, Part 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xelian was first mentioned in the [[2011]] novel [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']], written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="Knight Errant" /> She was first pictured in a flashback in the [[Knight Errant: Escape 3|thirteenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series, which was also written by Miller, penciled by [[Marco Castiello]],<ref name="Escape, Part 3" /> and released on [[August 8]], [[2012]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54317/star_wars_knight_errant_-_escape_2012_3|text=Star Wars: Knight Errant - Escape (2012) #3}}</ref>
